closed_defects: D13 - /api/chat answered a payload it did not understand; fixed 2026-09-17 and verified against the live console
D15 - fixed .json.tmp name in four persistence modules killed the stick console mid-chat (WinError 32); src/atomicio.py added
D16 - reader-vs-writer WinError 5 on the same index under load; per-path lock + no-op rewrite skip + bounded retry + in-place fallback
D17 - readers denied Errno 13 for the instant of a swap; atomicio.read_text() now retries transient denials on every state read
D18 - stick port contract 9651/11451/11452; foreign 8080 and 11434 never claimed, enforced by tests/test_usb_portability.py
D19 - the stick MODEL_MANIFEST.json contradicted itself (llama3.1:8b vs qwen2.5:3b); data-fixed with backup
D20 - every GPU plan advertised flash_attn:true while spawn_runner() passed no flag; now plumbed, default off (opt-in via console.json)
D21 - a GGUF that parses but will not load killed the boot; model_verdicts.json keeps a per-host verdict and falls back to the next brain
D22 - the console ignored the LYGO_MODELS/OLLAMA_MODELS roots its own launcher declares; default_scan_roots() now trusts them and descends into a CAS parent
D23 - mmap=False emitted --no-mmap, dead in this engine build; mapped to -lm none

D24 - POST /api/chat {"tools": false} returned 500 handler_failed (UnboundLocalError: honest_pending): honest_pending/traces were bound inside `if use_tools:` and read unguarded. Fixed by hoisting above the branch; three tests drive the real handler, and the live console now answers tools=true, tools=false and omitted

D25 - plan_ngl() charged NOTHING for the KV cache, so a plan could promise layers the card cannot hold; the cache is now sized from the model's own GGUF header (57,344 B/token for this 7B) with a flat 256 MiB allowance only when the dims cannot be read

D26 - the KV sizing used the model's native 32768 ctx while the engine runs clamped to 16384: a 2x over-charge (896 MiB) that could have demoted a GPU that fits. Sizing now goes through the same clamp_ctx() the launch uses (448 MiB - matches the card)

D27 - the GGUF header scan broke on attention.head_count instead of attention.head_count_kv, so GQA models fell back to the flat allowance and the console mis-answered kv_mib:256. Break tightened to the GQA key; a no-head_count_kv model is correctly read as MHA

D28 - data/.llama_api_key held the literal placeholder 'secret-key' and ensure_llama_key() returned it forever: the engine's only guard on loopback was a published default. Placeholders and sub-16-char values are now treated as absent and replaced with a generated per-install key; the live engine's --api-key matches the rotated file

D29 - the suite leaked resources (test_openai_proxy: shutdown() without server_close(); test_backends: a TemporaryDirectory per test, 24 of them, reclaimed only by the GC), so -W error::ResourceWarning was not green and the failing test moved between runs. Both released explicitly; strict run now 372 passed / 0 warnings, three consecutive runs

D30 - four tests wrote the operator's REAL state (MEMORY.md + memory.jsonl, the live workspace map, the live notepad) and cleaned up by hand, so concurrent suite runs collided on one file and a killed run left junk: the live kit held 239 test rows in workspace/memory.jsonl and 120 dead temp paths in save/workspace_map.json. Each test now runs against a throwaway dir; two concurrent strict suites pass 372 and a full run leaves the live files unchanged. Junk pruned 2026-09-18, backups in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp\lygo_kit_debris\state_prune_20260918

docs.rule: update the canonical copy, then re-copy to every archive location in the same change
docs.index_tool: tools/make_index.py - AST module/function index = whitepaper Appendix B (regenerated this pass)

prompt_budget.rule: the system prompt is never trimmed; trim_history() drops old turns first
prompt_budget.note: the engine window is headroom, not a target: continuity.PROMPT_CEILING still caps the composed prompt at 16300 chars, leaving room for history, tool traces and the answer

invariants: local is the default brain and is complete on its own; the API is additive and must degrade to local
one source of truth per fact: the effective brain is threaded into compose_system(), never re-derived from saved state
the host never authors the answer: facts are injected, limbs pre-run, placeholders repaired in place
runtime facts (build, model, engine, brain, standby) are always present in the prompt
the public gateway has no limbs, no disks, no admin map, no steward data; P0 gates input and output
credentials are never printed, never transported to the USB, never embedded in documents or prompts, always [REDACTED]
every turn returns a receipt id; a claimed action without a receipt is not a result
a placeholder credential is never a permanent credential: a stored default key is treated as absent and replaced at boot (D28)

data_safety.policy: never copied to the USB, never committed, never echoed; paths only

known_gaps: hosted portal mode is NOT live: web_portal/portal.json hosted_base is empty
image-only turns are accepted but the default local engine qwen2.5:3b has no vision
studio UI (portal/) and public UI (web_portal/) are duplicated trees
public gateway has no per-day quota or IP ban list
the 747 MB GPU backend store on the stick is not part of the public SKU; exclusion policy still to confirm

engine ctx is 16384 tokens per host plan (the coder model itself offers 32768): raising it further still needs a per-host KV-memory plan, and the console's own prompt ceiling is unchanged

pass_2026_09_18.model: qwen2.5-coder:7b (Q4_K_M), CUDA -ngl 99 -t 16, 8 GB RTX 4060 Ti (288 GB/s)
pass_2026_09_18.verdict: generation is memory-bandwidth locked: 56.5 tok/s is ~92% of the 288 GB/s ceiling for a 4.68 GB model, and no launch flag moved it. The pass therefore bought context headroom at identical VRAM (16384 + q8_0 KV = 448 MiB, exactly what 8192 + f16 cost) instead of chasing generation speed

draft_qwen2.5_1.5b.verdict: DEFERRED: +38% on code, -21% prefill, +1 GB VRAM, +10 s load, a second model to ship and validate

ctx16k_kv8_no_fa.verdict: ADOPTED: ~-1% live generation for 2x context at the same VRAM
